notes:
Summary: Hedgerow Market Labs is an online marketplace for niche home & garden goods. Use-case is catalog semantic search + product reranking during high-traffic commerce events. Key metrics: catalog ~4M SKUs (flat-parent SKUs, variants stripped), expect 3-5x traffic spikes on Black Friday/Cyber Week and seasonal peaks. Current infra: ElasticSearch for text, FAISS on self-managed infra for vectors; ops overhead high, cold-start rerank load causes timeouts during spikes.

Requirements / priorities (user quote highlights):
- "We need sub-200ms p95 for search results in normal traffic and under 400ms p95 during spikes for rerank stage. We cannot accept a 2x hit to cost per query if it materially cuts conversion." — Maya Patel, Head of Search.
- Embedding scale: target index size 4M vectors now, planning 2x growth in 12 months. Working vector dim: 1536 (existing models), evaluating mixing higher-dim models for quality.
- Cost sensitivity: target end-to-end cost per query (semantic search + 3-item rerank) < $0.006 average; break-even requires batching and KV/cache reuse across similar queries.
- Availability & isolation: VPC private endpoints for catalog sync; audit logs and KMS for keys. SOC2 required, potential ISO conversation later.
- Routing/fallback: Need automated fallback to smaller quantized reranker or cheaper model in case Dedicated capacity saturates.

POC ask: Redwood to run a 2-week benchmark using a 4M-vector snapshot + 50k real queries (weekday + spike window) measuring: recall@10, rerank p95 latency, cost per query, GPU utilization, and autoscale behavior. Hedgerow wants a white-box cost breakdown (tokens, batch efficiency, KV cache hit rates).

Other notes (ops/threads):
- Legal: DPA in review (procurement blocker).
- SE work: SE to instrument sample pipeline and provide Prometheus traces for baseline.
- Sales: prefer Dedicated pricing with burst to hosted for peak weeks; open to Private if residency needed for EU expansion.

Stated blocker list: budget timing (Q2 commit preferred), legal SLA language on retention, access to anonymized catalog export (s3 link) for POC.
proposal_notes: Initial ask: Demo + POC pricing (Dedicated 8xA100 equivalent pool + burst policy) and Optimize run to suggest batching/cache profile. We recommended a canary rerank path: small quantized reranker for fallback and token-level cost reporting. SE action: prepare perf script + synthetic spike run by 2026-03-05.
technical_requirements_summary: Indexing: ~4M vectors (1536d). Latency targets: search p95 < 200ms, rerank p95 < 400ms under spike. Throughput: baseline 15k qps/day, peak 120k qps/day during BF window. Cost target: < $0.006 per query end-to-end. Security: VPC, SSO/SAML, SOC2, KMS, audit logs.
customer_quote: "Relevance lift has to be net-positive on conversion; we won't pay for marginal gains that double our infra cost. Prioritize smart batching and cheap fallback models." — Maya Patel
